# README.md

Source: https://github.com/jokergoo/circlize_book/blob/master/README.md

This book gives comprehensive overviews of circular visualization in R by using the [**circlize**](https://github.com/jokergoo/circlize) package. The book is available at [http://jokergoo.github.io/circlize_book/book](http://jokergoo.github.io/circlize_book/book).
